name: hybrid_neurram_sram_cim
description: Figure 1's mixed row (N2b, E-6): NeuRRAM static tiles beside an SRAM-CIM operand core type, declared as the neurram bundle with its cores overridden (target_overrides), each core type with its own write and compute technology. A design study: no published chip carries both, so it is a declaration over a published target, not a target bundle (a bundle names a published target, target_bundles.py).

cores.note: design study (N2b, E-6): NeuRRAM's 48 static cores of 256 x 256 (wan2022a p.505; written per cell by its write-verify iteration, wan2021edge p.9) beside one SRAM-CIM macro of 128 x 1024 as the operand core type (jiang2023a Section II p.2; written per 8-bit cell, the sram_cim_macro profile's t_write_per_unit); each core type's writes and MACs priced under its own technology (write_physics, compute_physics), every other constant NeuRRAM's; a study declares both counts
